updates.detailed_summary_zh: Tether于3月向濒临破产的生物制药公司NovaBay投资1.34亿美元，并通过反向合并将其改造为在纽交所上市、更名为Stablecoin Development Corporat的实体。该实体已被用于购买并质押大量USDS——即来自Sky Protocol（原MakerDAO）的去中心化稳定币。 这是值得关注的市场结构变化，因为全球最大的中心化稳定币发行方正在利用上市壳公司来积累竞争对手的去中心化稳定币。此举可能重塑稳定币竞争格局，引发治理与透明度方面的疑问，并让USDS获得公开市场的敞口。 Stablecoin Development Corporat的股价已从约2.00美元跌至1.00美元，且多次出现异常买盘将其推回1.00美元上方，显然是为了避免触发纽交所“连续30日低于1美元”的退市规则。该公司表示已持有USDS“超过9%的份额”，其CEO Michael Kazley称对SKY Protocol“极度看多”。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Tether invested $134 million in the failing biopharmaceutical firm NovaBay in March and reverse-merged it into a NYSE-listed entity renamed Stablecoin Development Corporat. The vehicle has been used to purchase and stake a large amount of USDS, the decentralized stablecoin from the Sky Protocol (formerly MakerDAO). This is a notable market-structure shift because the world's largest centralized stablecoin issuer is using a public shell company to accumulate a rival decentralized stablecoin. It could reshape stablecoin competition, raise governance and transparency questions, and give USDS public-market exposure. Stablecoin Development Corporat's share price has collapsed from roughly $2.00 to $1.00, and unusual buy support has repeatedly pushed it back above $1.00, apparently to avoid NYSE delisting under the 30-day sub-$1 rule. The company says it has taken a 'greater than a 9% stake' in USDS, and its CEO, Michael Kazley, describes the position as 'wildly bullish' on the SKY Protocol.
